description:
Job description:
  
  
Job Description

**Role Purpose**

The purpose of this role is to design, test and maintain software programs for operating systems or applications which needs to be deployed at a client end and ensure its meet 100% quality assurance parameters

͏

**Do**

1. Instrumental in understanding the requirements and design of the product/ software

* Develop software solutions by studying information needs, studying systems flow, data usage and work processes
* Investigating problem areas followed by the software development life cycle
* Facilitate root cause analysis of the system issues and problem statement
* Identify ideas to improve system performance and impact availability
* Analyze client requirements and convert requirements to feasible design
* Collaborate with functional teams or systems analysts who carry out the detailed investigation into software requirements
* Conferring with project managers to obtain information on software capabilities

͏

2. Perform coding and ensure optimal software/ module development

* Determine operational feasibility by evaluating analysis, problem definition, requirements, software development and proposed software
* Develop and automate processes for software validation by setting up and designing test cases/scenarios/usage cases, and executing these cases
* Modifying software to fix errors, adapt it to new hardware, improve its performance, or upgrade interfaces.
* Analyzing information to recommend and plan the installation of new systems or modifications of an existing system
* Ensuring that code is error free or has no bugs and test failure
* Preparing reports on programming project specifications, activities and status
* Ensure all the codes are raised as per the norm defined for project / program / account with clear description and replication patterns
* Compile timely, comprehensive and accurate documentation and reports as requested
* Coordinating with the team on daily project status and progress and documenting it
* Providing feedback on usability and serviceability, trace the result to quality risk and report it to concerned stakeholders

͏

3. Status Reporting and Customer Focus on an ongoing basis with respect to project and its execution

* Capturing all the requirements and clarifications from the client for better quality work
* Taking feedback on the regular basis to ensure smooth and on time delivery
* Participating in continuing education and training to remain current on best practices, learn new programming languages, and better assist other team members.
* Consulting with engineering staff to evaluate software-hardware interfaces and develop specifications and performance requirements
* Document and demonstrate solutions by developing documentation, flowcharts, layouts, diagrams, charts, code comments and clear code
* Documenting very necessary details and reports in a formal way for proper understanding of software from client proposal to implementation
* Ensure good quality of interaction with customer w.r.t. e-mail content, fault report tracking, voice calls, business etiquette etc
* Timely Response to customer requests and no instances of complaints either internally or externally

͏

**Deliver**

**No.**
**Performance Parameter**
**Measure**
1.Continuous Integration, Deployment & Monitoring of Software100% error free on boarding & implementation, throughput %, Adherence to the schedule/ release plan2.Quality & CSATOn-Time Delivery, Manage software, Troubleshoot queries, Customer experience, completion of assigned certifications for skill upgradation3.MIS & Reporting100% on time MIS & report generation

Mandatory Skills: Boomi Integration
  
.

Experience: 5-8 Years
  
.

Of yourself, your career, and your skills. We want to see the constant evolution of our business and our industry. It has always been in our DNA - as the world around us changes, so do we. Join a business powered by purpose and a place that empowers you to design your own reinvention.

title: Senior System Software Engineer - GPU
description:
NVIDIA is seeking an outstanding Senior System Software Engineer to join our Display Driver team. You will develop production-quality system software for next-generation NVIDIA GPU and Tegra platforms, working across operating systems such as Linux and Android.
  
  
The role combines broad kernel-mode driver development with opportunities to work on display security technologies, including High-bandwidth Digital Content Protection (HDCP). You will collaborate with hardware, firmware, security, and system software teams to deliver reliable and secure display solutions.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Design, develop, test, and maintain GPU/display kernel-mode drivers and embedded firmware.
* Develop system software across Linux, Android or similar operating system.
* Implement and maintain HDCP and related display-content-protection functionality.
* Debug interactions across software, firmware, hardware, and external display devices.
* Develop multithreaded, performance-sensitive software in C.
* Participate in design, code, and security reviews.
* Build automated tests and diagnostic tools to improve reliability and interoperability.
* Collaborate with teams across NVIDIA and external partners throughout the product lifecycle.

**What We Need To See**

* BS or MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 5+ years of experience developing system software, embedded software, firmware, or kernel-mode drivers.
* Strong C programming and debugging skills.
* Solid understanding of operating-system fundamentals, computer architecture, memory management, synchronization, and concurrency.
* Experience developing low-level software on Linux, Android, or a similar operating system.
* Familiarity with secure protocols, cryptographic concepts, authentication, key management, or content-protection technologies.
* Strong analytical, communication, and collaboration skills.

**Ways to stand out from the crowd**

* Experience implementing or debugging HDCP 1.x/2.x authentication and content-protection flows.
* Knowledge of HDMI, DisplayPort, USB-C DisplayPort Alt Mode, DDC/I²C, or DisplayPort AUX protocols.
* Experience with Linux DRM/KMS or graphics/display kernel drivers.
* Familiarity with trusted execution environments, secure firmware, hardware security modules, or secure key provisioning.
* Experience in debugging display interoperability, or content-protection certification issues.

description:
**Job Summary**
**Job Description**
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for an experienced Developer Analyst - IT with strong hands-on expertise in the Microsoft .NET ecosystem. The role will design, develop, enhance, and support scalable enterprise applications, full-stack solutions, and APIs while working closely with product, architecture, business, quality assurance, and engineering teams.
  
  
The successful candidate will combine strong .NET development skills with Microsoft Azure experience and practical exposure to Generative AI solutions.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain enterprise applications using C# and .NET/.NET Core.
* Build scalable full-stack applications, REST APIs, and microservices using Microsoft technologies.
* Translate business and functional requirements into secure, reliable, and maintainable technical solutions.
* Contribute to application architecture, technical design, API design, and database design discussions.
* Develop and optimize database solutions using SQL Server and Entity Framework or other ORM technologies.
* Apply Object-Oriented Programming principles, SOLID principles, and appropriate design patterns.
* Integrate applications with internal and external APIs and enterprise services.
* Improve application performance, scalability, reliability, security, and maintainability.
* Troubleshoot complex application and production issues and perform root-cause analysis.
* Build and maintain automated deployment processes using Azure DevOps and CI/CD pipelines.
* Participate in code reviews, unit testing, technical documentation, release activities, and production support.
* Contribute to Generative AI use cases and AI-enabled capabilities within enterprise applications.
* Collaborate effectively with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Architects, QA, DevOps, and development teams.
* Mentor junior developers and promote development standards and engineering best practices.

**Required Experience**

* 6-10 years of overall software development experience, preferably in full-stack application development.
* Strong hands-on experience across the .NET ecosystem.
* Approximately 1-2 years of hands-on experience or project exposure in Generative AI.
* Strong experience with Microsoft Azure technologies and cloud-based application delivery.
* Experience developing and supporting enterprise-grade applications.

Must-Have Technical Skills
  
  

* Strong expertise in C# and .NET Core 6+
* ASP.NET Core and Web API development.
* Experience developing REST APIs and microservices.
* Strong understanding of Object-Oriented Programming, SOLID principles, and design patterns.
* Strong experience with SQL Server and database development.
* Strong understanding of Entity Framework or equivalent ORM technologies.
* Experience with secure application development, authentication and authorization, and API integration.
* Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

Good-to-Have Skills
  
  

* HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and TypeScript.
* Experience with a modern frontend framework such as Angular or React.
* Experience with Azure PaaS services, including Azure App Service.
* Experience with Azure DevOps and CI/CD pipelines.
* Application performance tuning, scalability, and production troubleshooting.
* Automated testing and unit-testing frameworks.
* Application monitoring and observability tools such as Application Insights.
* Cloud-native development and containerization.

Generative AI Experience
  
  
Experience in one or more of the following areas will be preferred:
  
  

* Integrating Generative AI capabilities into enterprise applications.
* Experience working with GitHub Copilot
* Large Language Models and prompt engineering.
* Azure OpenAI Service or a comparable enterprise AI platform.
* Retrieval-Augmented Generation, embeddings, or vector search.
* AI API integration with .NET applications.

Key Competencies
  
  

* Strong analytical thinking and structured problem-solving.
* Ownership and accountability for technical deliverables.
* Good understanding of enterprise application architecture.
* Clear communication and effective collaboration with business and technical stakeholders.
* Ability to work independently and provide technical guidance to other developers.
* Interest in continuously learning cloud-native and Generative AI technologies.

Ideal Candidate
  
  
A hands-on .NET Full Stack professional who can independently design and deliver backend and API solutions, work effectively with SQL Server and Microsoft Azure, understand modern frontend technologies, troubleshoot complex production issues, and contribute to the adoption of Generative AI within enterprise applications.
  
  
**About Medline India**
Medline India was setup in 2010 in Pune, primarily as an offshore Development centre and to augment resources for Medline Industries LP headquartered in Chicago, USA. We are a 1500+ strong and growing team of technology, finance & and business support professionals who support our businesses worldwide towards a mission to make healthcare run better. We are proud to be certified as a ‘Great Place to Work’ by the Great Place to Work Institute® (India) for the duration May 2023 – May 2024.
  
  
We are an organization with a conducive work environment, ample opportunities to learn, contribute and grow with a highly empowered & engaged team. We encourage our people to share their best ideas and create new opportunities for our customers and ourselves to work together to solve today’s toughest healthcare challenges.
  
  
**About Medline Industries, LP**
Established in 1966, Medline Industries LP is a renowned global healthcare organization boasting 56 years of consecutive sales growth, exceeding $21 billion in annual sales. With a workforce of over 36,000 professionals spread across the globe, we operate in more than 125 countries and territories. As the largest privately held manufacturer and distributor of medical supplies in the United States, Medline is uniquely positioned to offer comprehensive products, education, and support across the continuum of care.
  
  
At present, Medline Industries, LP holds the esteemed position as the #1 market leader, delivering an extensive portfolio of over 550,000 medical products and clinical solutions. Our clientele includes hospitals, extended care facilities, surgery centres, physician offices, home care agencies, providers, and retailers. We are proud to be recognized by Forbes as one of America’s Best Large Employers and Best Employers for Women. Additionally, the Chicago Tribune has consistently named us a Top Workplace for the past 12 years.

description:
**Job Description**
We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to be the technical leader for this team. In this role, you’ll define and drive the architecture, execution strategy, and long-term technical roadmap. You’ll lead the development of a feature-rich system that helps company admins onboard, adopt, and manage Zendesk products with ease, while also empowering internal teams to integrate their solutions efficiently.
  
  
If you’re passionate about building meaningful experiences, driving platform excellence, and creating extensible systems that serve both customers and internal teams, we’d love to have you on this journey.
  
  
Our ideal candidate is someone who takes the lead on anything they work on and is a self-starter with projects that has the initiative to drive a project from start to finish.
  
  
**This role is based in Pune and requires you to work from office at least 3 days a week**
**What You’ll Get To Do Each Day**

* Contribute to the code at the core of Zendesk’s support product - what you write will reach millions of people each day!
* Break complex features into granular pieces of work, to facilitate incremental feedback cycles.
* Take ownership of features and collaborate with the Tech Leaders to design and implement complete solutions.
* Contribute to technical discussions and decision-making with other teams and partners across the global engineering organisation.
* Prioritise and estimate work balancing feature delivery with the management of tech debt.
* Participate in and lead activities such as pairing sessions and code reviews to facilitate continuous self-improvement for the whole team.
* Work closely with our designers and product managers to help define the future of the product.
* Triage customer issues in partnership with Product Managers.
* Provide operational support for our services in Production.
* Actively look for ways to improve the observability, performance, reliability and security of our services.
* Show strategic forward-thinking and provide technical leadership to drive near-to-mid-term success (1-2 years).

**What You Bring To The Role**

* 9+ years of experience in full-stack software engineering, with expertise in building enterprise-scale SaaS or large web applications.
* Strong proficiency in any of the programming languages - Java, Ruby on Rails, GoLang, Scala, Typescript, NodeJs or any other object oriented language.
* 9+ years of experience working with JavaScript and TypeScript, as well as frameworks like React and Redux.
* Solid experience with MySQL or similar. A knack for writing efficient queries and optimizing performance in high-traffic environments.
* Good to have - experience/knowledge of front end technologies
* A track record of delivering large-scale, high quality, and resilient web systems.
* Strong verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills in English - you’ll collaborate with our other product teams around the globe.
* The ability to understand and communicate sophisticated concepts in a relevant and considerate manner. Explain and reason your technical decisions clearly and effectively to engineers of different levels and non-technical partners.
* Experience solving difficult problems across multiple systems.
* Experience coaching engineers, leading brainstorming discussions, and facilitating engineers working together to make decisions in a collaborative environment.
* Ability to influence without authority, inspire and mentor others.
* A culture of learning, growth, and innovation.
* You’re comfortable jumping into unfamiliar codebases and languages.

**Tech Stack**

* You’ll be working on one of the largest Ruby on Rails codebases in the world!
* Most of the team’s data is stored in MySQL and Redis.
* We occasionally work in other adjacent services in Go and Java.
* Our services connect with other services via a combination of gRPC, REST APIs, Kafka event streams, and GraphQL.
* Our services are deployed to Kubernetes using Docker via Spinnaker, running on AWS. We don’t require previous experience with these specific technologies; we’re confident you can learn as we go.
* We monitor and observe our production systems using Datadog

Please note that Zendesk can only hire candidates who are physically located and plan to work from Karnataka or Maharashtra. Please refer to the location posted on the requisition for where this role is based.

These responsibilities include structuring, credit analysis and rating recommendations, client credit monitoring tasks, and credit terms and documentation negotiation with Wholesale Credit and Market Risk and clients. The Business Credit Office will act as a single handoff from a Relationship Manager to the Business Credit Office for all Credit and Lending tasks, creating a single control point. The function will be client-facing and customer-service-oriented.
  
  
The Business Credit Office Manager provides credit management support to Relationship Managers and Coverage, and facilitates client review and renewal activities. The role is responsible for carrying out customer outreach, research, financial analysis and credit analysis on behalf of the Relationship Managers, ensuring exemplary risk management acumen and control standards are embedded within the end-to-end Credit and Lending process.
  
  
In discharging their duties, the role holder must ensure a common, reliable and predictable underwriting and lending process that protects the business from exposure while responding to clients’ borrowing needs. They are also responsible for the coordination and completion of credit applications or renewals and risk escalation management.
  
  
The role holder will report to the Business Credit Office Team Lead and will work closely with the Coverage and Transaction Support teams to ensure a seamless customer experience and consistency of service for all customers.
  
  
The Business Credit Office Manager will need to be an effective collaborator and skilled stakeholder manager, successfully navigating a complex landscape to deliver exceptional outcomes for our customers and stakeholders.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Responsible for the delivery of Business Credit Office tasks in line with agreed Objectives and Key Results, Service Level Agreements and Key Performance Indicators.
* Own the end-to-end Credit and Lending servicing journey, ensuring a seamless and efficient process for customers and internal stakeholders.
* Combine client relationship management with strong risk assessment and management capabilities, ensuring the required credit quality and requisite returns on risk.
* Continuously drive improvement in productivity while enhancing client experience.
* Adopt technology and customer experience improvement initiatives, including alignment to a globally consistent Credit and Lending operating model and active participation in training initiatives.
* Participate in deal discussions and meetings with clients or Credit Risk, as required.
* Demonstrate strong execution and implementation ability.
* Build and maintain strong relationships across teams, including credibility with both Business and Risk leaders.
* Protect the Bank by acting as the First Line of Defence and adhering to all controls.
* Maintain HSBC internal control standards, including the timely implementation of internal and external audit recommendations, along with addressing any issues raised by external regulators.
* Demonstrate the ability to engage in constructive and consistent dialogue with Risk partners in a manner that effectively balances commercial outcomes and risk management.
* Work with the Business Credit Office Team Lead to ensure adequate credit risk management controls are built into the operational process and robust management information is in place to track and measure risk against agreed thresholds.

Knowledge and Experience
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in business, finance or a related field.
* Strong accounting, analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Proficient in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft PowerPoint.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver under tight deadlines.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to navigate complex situations and drive alignment among senior leaders.
* Strong commercial mindset.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively across all levels of the organisation.
* Familiarity with artificial intelligence-enabled tools is an advantage.
* Mandatory successful completion of Anti-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and the post-course assessment, as required.

As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity, exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable, and taking accountability for delivery outcomes.
  
  
You will represent the organisation with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritise work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy, as applicable.
  
  
Additional Information
  
  
The tenure of the Apprentice will be one year, as defined under the Apprentices Act, 1961 and the Apprenticeship Rules, 1992, as amended from time to time.

All other clauses regarding the tenure of engagement as an Apprentice with HSBC will remain as stated in the offer letter issued by the Bank at the time of joining.
  
  
You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

description:
**Job Description**
**Senior Demo Platform Architect – Contact Center and Customer Experience**
**Position Overview:**
We are seeking a seasoned Senior Demo Platform Engineer with deep expertise in contact center technologies and CX suites, preferably Zendesk, Amazon Connect, and AWS. This role will own the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of shared demo environments and reusable customer service use cases. The ideal candidate will combine hands-on technical expertise, strong operational ownership, and independent decision-making to ensure demo environments remain reliable, current, scalable, and ready to support both internal teams and occasional customer-facing engagements.
  
  
**Core Daily Activities**

* Own and Optimize Demo Environments – Maintain reliable, scalable, secure, and high-quality shared demo environments leveraging Amazon Connect, AWS, and Zendesk.
* Develop New Demo Use Cases – Design and build compelling, reusable demonstrations that showcase contact center, customer experience, AI, automation, analytics, and integration capabilities.
* Support Custom Demo Requests – Partner with presales specialists and architects to develop opportunity-specific configurations, integrations, workflows, and demonstrations.
* Maintain Product and Release Readiness – Track Zendesk, Amazon Connect, AWS, and related technology releases and incorporate relevant capabilities into the demo portfolio.
* Drive Automation and Standardization – Develop reusable components, templates, deployment processes, and automation to improve the speed and consistency of demo delivery.
* Ensure Security, Governance, and Best Practices – Maintain appropriate access controls, data standards, platform governance, cost management, and technical quality across demo environments.
* Support Customer-Facing Activities – Occasionally participate in customer demonstrations, proof of concepts (PoCs), technical discussions, and presentations for prospects and clients.
* Develop Technical Documentation and Demo Collateral – Create technical guides, setup instructions, troubleshooting documentation, architecture diagrams, demo scripts, and internal enablement materials.
* Engage with Vendors and Partners – Work closely with AWS, Zendesk, and other partners to remain aligned with product capabilities, best practices, and technology advancements.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Demo Platform Ownership: Define and execute the technical vision for shared demo environments, proactively identifying improvements, resolving issues, and ensuring environments remain available and ready for use.
* Demo Design and Development: Build compelling end-to-end contact center demonstrations leveraging Zendesk, Amazon Connect, and AWS services to showcase customer experience, agent productivity, AI, automation, and operational performance.
* Integration Management: Design and maintain integrations between Zendesk, Amazon Connect, AWS, and other enterprise systems to support realistic workflows, consistent data, and reusable demo scenarios.
* Custom Demo Support: Work with presales specialists and architects to understand opportunity requirements and deliver tailored demonstrations while identifying opportunities to create reusable assets for the wider team.
* Technical Oversight: Establish and maintain high standards for demo architecture, configuration, testing, security, documentation, reliability, and overall presentation quality.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Engage with internal teams, business leaders, product specialists, engineering teams, customers, and external partners to gather requirements, propose solutions, communicate tradeoffs, and deliver effective demonstrations.
* Innovation and Best Practices: Stay ahead of product releases, industry trends, and emerging technologies in contact center platforms, AI, and automation, applying them to continuously improve the demo portfolio.
* Independent Execution: Establish priorities, manage multiple concurrent requests, make informed decisions, and deliver outcomes without requiring detailed day-to-day direction.
* Governance: Establish and enforce governance frameworks for security, access control, data management, cost optimization, platform reliability, and lifecycle management of demo environments.

**Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or Business Administration - or equivalent experience.
* Experience: Minimum of 8–10 years in solution engineering, platform engineering, solution architecture, software development, or a related technical field, with at least 5 years of experience in contact center technologies, including Amazon Connect and CRM/CX technologies, preferably Zendesk.
* Technical Expertise: Strong proficiency in designing, implementing, and supporting scalable solutions using a CRM/CX platform, Amazon Connect, AWS Lambda, Amazon AI Agents (Bedrock), Amazon Lex, IAM, DynamoDB, S3, API Gateway, CloudWatch, and other AWS services. We will rank you higher if you have experience or exposure to Python and/or NodeJS.
* Demo Development: Demonstrated experience creating technical demonstrations, reusable use cases, prototypes, proof of concepts, or reference implementations that translate technical capabilities into compelling business scenarios.
* Platform Management: Experience maintaining shared technical environments, managing releases and configuration changes, troubleshooting complex issues, and proactively improving platform availability and reliability.
* Leadership Skills: Demonstrated ability to operate with ownership, take initiative, work independently, influence cross-functional teams, and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced and globally distributed environment.
* Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to document technical solutions, collaborate across time zones, and articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a track record of investigating root causes, making sound decisions with incomplete information, and developing scalable solutions to complex challenges.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Certifications: Zendesk certifications, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, or equivalent credentials in contact center platforms.
* Industry Knowledge: Experience designing and demonstrating omnichannel contact center solutions, including voice, chat, messaging, AI-driven automation, agent assistance, Workforce Engagement Management, including workforce and quality management, and contact center reporting and analytics tools.
* Customer Engagement: Experience delivering technical demonstrations, supporting customer discussions, and responding to detailed technical questions during customer or prospect engagements.
* Agile Methodologies: Experience working within Agile and DevOps frameworks, including source control, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, automated testing, and repeatable deployment practices.
